[{"step":1,"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat","line":1000,"var":"ctx->data","code":"ret = read_data(ctx, sizeof_sig_ihdr); data = ctx->data;","note":"Attacker-controlled PNG bytes are loaded into the parser buffer and become the source for chunk parsing."},{"step":2,"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat","line":1004,"var":"ctx->ihdr","code":"ctx->ihdr.width = read_u32(data + 16); ... memcpy(&ctx->ihdr.interlace_method, data + 28, 1);","note":"The IHDR values are copied from the input and establish the image dimensions and format used later for decoding."},{"step":3,"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat","line":1032,"var":"ctx->first_idat","code":"if(!memcmp(chunk.type, type_idat, 4)) { memcpy(&ctx->first_idat, &chunk, sizeof(struct spng_chunk)); return 0; }","note":"Parsing stops at the first IDAT and caches its location, leaving later IDAT/ancillary structure to be interpreted on demand."},{"step":4,"file":"spng.c","function":"get_ancillary","line":1658,"var":"ctx->first_idat.offset","code":"if(!ctx->first_idat.offset) { ret = read_chunks_before_idat(ctx); ... }","note":"A size query forces ancillary parsing if it has not already been done, re-entering the chunk scan."},{"step":5,"file":"spng.c","function":"spng_decoded_image_size","line":2457,"var":"out_size_required","code":"int ret = get_ancillary(ctx);","note":"The image-size API is the entry point that triggers the vulnerable metadata walk before any decode buffer is allocated."},{"step":6,"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_after_idat","line":1473,"var":"ctx->last_idat","code":"memcpy(&chunk, &ctx->last_idat, sizeof(struct spng_chunk));","note":"After IDAT processing, the parser resumes from a cached IDAT position and scans the remaining chunks in attacker-controlled order."},{"step":7,"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_after_idat","line":1497,"var":"chunk.length","code":"ret = read_chunk_bytes(ctx, chunk.length);","note":"The parser reads the bytes of each following chunk into ctx->data, making the later ancillary payload available to validation and bookkeeping."},{"step":8,"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_after_idat","line":1505,"var":"ctx->stored","code":"else if(!memcmp(chunk.type, type_idat, 4) && prev_was_idat) continue;","note":"Multiple IDATs are skipped according to the current state, so malformed ordering can keep the parser traversing attacker-crafted chunk sequences."},{"step":9,"file":"spng.c","function":"spng_decode_image","line":1718,"var":"apply_trns / use_sbit / apply_gamma","code":"if(flags & SPNG_DECODE_USE_TRNS && ctx->stored & SPNG_CHUNK_TRNS) apply_trns = 1;","note":"Decode-time feature flags cause the decoder to consume metadata gathered during the chunk walk."},{"step":10,"file":"spng.c","function":"spng_decode_image","line":1736,"var":"scanline","code":"... scale_row(row, pixels, fmt, ctx->ihdr.bit_depth, &ctx->sbit);","note":"The decoder uses the stored metadata while transforming rows, which is the execution path that eventually reaches the memory-safety fault in the reported crash."}]
JSON
cp /workspace/reproducer.bin /workspace/poc.bin
python3 - <<'PY'
print('trace and poc ready')
PY
